title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead cross-functional hardware and software development programs. You will work closely with engineering, supply chain, and product delivery teams to deliver error-free high performance products.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead cross-functional program teams from product concept to commercial release.
- Manage program risk, product lifecycle management (PLM), and stakeholder alignment.
- Drive quality assurance and operational excellence across product delivery.

Requirements:
- 6+ years in Technical Program Management.
- Experience in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Agile/Waterfall, and Risk Management.
- Proven track record of cross-functional team leadership and error-free execution.

title: Materials Program Manager
description: We are seeking a proactive Materials Program Manager to lead hardware component strategy and BOM management for next-generation devices.

title: Senior Supply Chain Analyst
description: AeroTech Solutions is looking for a Senior Supply Chain Analyst to drive data-driven decision making in global procurement and logistics.
